title: Group scoped follow-up due preview by status or salesperson
description: A user groups the currently authorized bounded follow-up reminder page by due status or salesperson and sees counts next to detail. Extend existing request/page DTO with finite groupBy none, dueStatus or salesman; reject other values before source reads. Compute counts only from scoped, already paged CustomerFollowUp entities, with clear unassigned-person label, then project only selected detail columns. Designer retains group choice across page/filter changes. Counts mean current page, never unbounded whole-data total. Existing HTTP operation logging audits preview. Development only: no schema or migration changes, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused service/UI tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Preview accepts only none/dueStatus/salesman grouping; invalid keys fail before reads and current-user menu and salesperson scope are checked on every call.
Groups count only authorized current-page rows with stable labels, including unassigned salesperson, while detail columns remain selected and out-of-scope rows stay hidden.
Designer displays current-page counts and retains group selection across bounded pages; validation/scope/empty/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
